findings.title: robots.txt blocks important pages that the audit needed to read
findings.evidence: 4 of 37 fetched-or-attempted URLs were disallowed by robots.txt, including 3 important page(s). Metrics: pages_checked=37; blocked_pages=4.

suggested_action.summary: Allow crawlers to fetch public marketing, product, and about URLs in robots.txt.

findings.title: No JSON-LD structured data was observed on crawled pages
findings.evidence: No parseable JSON-LD was observed on 12 crawled HTML page(s). This is a coverage statement about the crawled set, not a claim about unfetched URLs.

suggested_action.summary: Add Product/Offer JSON-LD to every product page.

findings.title: Important information is missing from raw HTML and appears only after rendering
findings.evidence: Raw HTML visible-text length: 421 words. Rendered visible-text length: 2781 words. Important facts found only after rendering: product description, pricing, product name.

suggested_action.summary: Server-render or prerender titles, prices, and primary descriptions in HTML.

findings.title: Homepage does not orient a first-time visitor
findings.evidence: The homepage contains 5 primary navigation destinations but no visible statement identifying the target audience, and the first CTA routes to a generic contact page.

suggested_action.summary: Add a specific H1, one sentence on who the site is for, and one primary CTA on the homepage.

findings.title: The primary brand name is under-specified on the site itself
findings.evidence: Primary observed name(s) ['Atlas'] lack a combination of industry + location + legal suffix + sameAs on the crawled pages.

suggested_action.summary: Add a one-sentence disambiguator (what + where) and sameAs links to official profiles.

findings.title: Time-sensitive pages have no usable freshness signal
findings.evidence: 2 pricing/article page(s) use time-sensitive language, but freshness cannot be established from structured or visible dates.

suggested_action.summary: Add a visible last-updated date and dateModified on time-sensitive templates.

proactive_recommendations.summary: Add a 2–3 sentence factual summary block that a machine can quote verbatim
proactive_recommendations.why_it_matters: A compact fact box is what assistants copy.
proactive_recommendations.what_to_change: Place an unambiguous summary near the H1.
